data.title: Benjamin Netanyahu says Donald Trump controls Iran war, discussed options to end conflict | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: Netanyahu denied pressuring Trump to enter or escalate the Iran war, saying the US president is the "senior partner" as the two leaders discussed the Hormuz blockade and further military action.
